دُعْمِىٌّ A strong thing: (TA:) a thing having a strong support or prop or stay. (K, TA.) ＝
-A2- A carpenter; syn. نَجَّارٌ. (K.) ＝
-A3- A horse having a whiteness in his breast: or, in his لَبَّة [app. as meaning the pit above the breast]: and so ↓ أَدْعَمُ : (K:) accord. to AA, this latter term is applied when there is a whiteness in a horse's breast; (TA;) and its pl. is دُعْمٌ. (TA in art. دغم.) ＝
-A4- The main part of a road: or the middle thereof. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
